summary: Technical exports are complete, but final-size visual QA found clipped wide tables, severe long-label collisions in heatmaps, and local panel/text crowding; the suite is not visually approved.

per_figure_review.finding: Hierarchy and protocol color semantics are clear; no blocking overlap observed.
Panels are readable; dense species labels and legend require final-size check.
Panel structure is clear; external-status boxes are intentionally non-quantitative.
Panel d species labels collide/compete with bars and the color scale; re-layout required.
Panel a evidence-scale text overlaps within the box; reflow or widen the box.
Panel d has crowded species labels/legend; improve left margin and label placement.
Adapter registry is a wide table with clipped columns and unreadable cell content.
Heatmap y-axis method labels overlap into an unreadable block.
Benchmark matrix columns are clipped and text is not readable at final size.
Marker-summary table is clipped on the right and long values are not legible.
Per-species heatmap labels overlap severely; split or abbreviate labels.
Wide source tables are clipped; Supplementary Figures 5 and 6 also have severe heatmap/table label collisions.

hard_blockers: At least five final figures contain clipped table columns or right-edge content.
At least four heatmap/table panels have overlapping labels that prevent reliable reading.
The main-figure suite is not approved for editorial visual quality despite complete exports.
minimum_revision_actions: Re-render wide tables with wrapped/shortened headers, sufficient canvas width, and no clipped right edge.
Split or abbreviate long heatmap y-axis labels and verify readability at final journal size.
Re-layout Figure 4d, Figure 5a, and Figure 6d to remove local text/panel crowding, then rerun the audit.
review_method: Automated figure export, source-data, editable-SVG, TIFF-DPI and minimum-font audit.
Manual original-resolution raster inspection after final re-render.
Figure claims cross-checked against the v17, v14, GSE270140 and GSE270342 audit records.
non_negotiable_boundaries: Strict v17 leave-species all-cell accuracy remains 0.39959636730575174.
The v14 context-aware result remains a global sensitivity analysis and not a nested primary result.
Both root adapters remain same-study supervised adaptation results.
The label-free external root case remains marker-coherence evidence without external accuracy.
Third-party scPlantLLM and scPlantAnnotate matched numerical comparisons remain incomplete.
